release_read.basis: Non-GAAP EPS $0.63 against a $0.40-0.50 guide and ~$0.45 consensus, on gross margin 16.0% above the 14.5-15.5% guide, and a Q4 EPS guide of $0.65-0.75 well above the Q3 bar, with 'visibility well into 2027'; offset by Q3 revenue a hair short ($328.7m vs ~$330m) and a Q4 revenue midpoint of $355m below the ~$364m consensus, on a stock down ~40% in 20 days with 10% bullish sentiment.

release.headline: Ichor Holdings, Ltd. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

vs_bar.consensus_source: company guide 14.5-15.5% from Q2 call (midpoint used; no street figure found)

key_line.detail: Q4 revenue $345-365m (mid $355m, below ~$364m consensus and the ~$360m implied by 'H2 25% above H1'), non-GAAP EPS $0.65-0.75; range includes supply-chain constraints and commercial-space launch pushouts. Q3 non-GAAP op margin 8.6%. CEO: 'Customer demand remains robust, with visibility extending well into 2027.'

guidance.detail: Sequential growth guided in revenue (+8% at mid), margin and EPS; EPS guide strong, revenue guide slightly below street; supply constraints named again.

call.detail: Call held last night (1:30pm PT). Coverage frames it as profit beat on margin, demand visibility into 2027, supply-chain and commercial-space pushouts as the reason for the conservative revenue range; Investing.com headline says the stock 'steadies'/'gains' on the Q4 guide. Transcript not read in detail for time.

public_reaction.summary: Headlines: 'Ichor stock gains on strong Q4 guidance despite revenue miss' (Investing.com), 'Q3 earnings beat EPS estimates but revenue slightly misses' (GuruFocus). No price-target changes from this morning found in search. Retail tone not checked for time.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was that peers (Lam, UCTT, ASML) implied a Q3 at/above midpoint and a Q4 guide at/above ~$360m. Q3 revenue landed at the midpoint, margin and EPS well above; the Q4 revenue guide is a little below that bar but EPS guide is strong. Supply-constraint risk flagged in the hunt did reappear in the Q4 range wording. Mostly confirms.

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market is thin and stale (7 prints, last 08:42), so the open is less reliable than usual and could print anywhere between the after-hours +0.7% and the +6.7% high; earnings gaps of ~6% tend to give a point back by 10:00, and an amc reaction has had the night.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de long: winst en marge ruim boven verwachting, de omzetprognose voor Q4 iets onder wat de markt hoopte. De voorbeurs staat al ongeveer 6% hoger, dicht bij wat de cijfers rechtvaardigen, en na een nachtcijfer geeft zo'n koerssprong in de loop van de dag vaak iets terug. Geen reden om af te wijken van de vaste regel: verkopen bij de opening.
